mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 5% and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for three consecutive months and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% MoM signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is increasing, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy and inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS MoM > 300,000 and 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% YoY and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 2% YoY, it signals robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST YoY > 10% and RSAFS YoY > 2% and 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% QoQ signals a contraction in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 QoQ < -1% and 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.
